title: Welfare's Synthetic Indicator function — p2distance
text: main function package. calculates Pena distance indicator, also called DP2, used measure welfare quality--life applications, create Environmental Quality Indexes, etc. (see references). multidimensional indicator capable aggregate various partial indicators (variables) unique measure compare state different spatial entities. P2 Distance spatial entity r definied $$ DP_{2}=\sum^{n}_{=1}\left\lbrace\left(\frac{d_{}}{\sigma_{}}\right)\left(1-R^{2}_{,-1,-2,\ldots,1}\right)\right\rbrace$$ \(R^{2}_{1}=0\); \(d_{}=|x_{ri}-x_{*}|\) reference base \(X_{*}=\left(x_{*1},x_{*2},\ldots,x_{*n}\right)\) : n number variables \(x_{ri}\), value variable spatial entity r \(\sigma_{}\) standard deviation variable \(R^{2}_{,-1,\ldots,1}\) coefficient determination regression \(X_{}\) \(X_{-1}, X_{-2}, \ldots,X_{1}\) already included. numerical value DP2 index real meaning, useful comparing state different spatial entities terms welfare, environmental conditions, etc.

title: Welfare's Synthetic Indicator function — p2distance
text: discrimination.coefficient Vector discrimination coefficients (DC) variable. value DC, defined Ivanovic (1974) $$DC_{}=\frac{2}{m(m-1)}\sum_{j,l>j}^{k_{}}m_{ji}m_{li}\left|\frac{x_{ji}-x_{li}}{\overline{X}_{}}\right|$$ m number spatial entities \(m_{ji}\) absolute frequency \(x_{ji}\). measure ranges 0 2. variable takes values spatial entities, DC equals zero, indicating zero discriminant power. contrast, variable value zero one spatial entity remainder \(m-1\), equal zero, DC reaches maximun value (2) variable full discriminant power (see Zarzosa, 1996; Zarzosa Somarriba, 2012). alternative way calculating coefficient, using Gini index,$$DC_{}=2\frac{m}{m-1}G$$ m number spatial entities G Gini index p2distance Vector last \(P_{2}\) distance value spatial entity p2distances Array vectors \(P_{2}\) distances values resulting iteration diff_p2distances Array differeces two contiguous \(P_{2}\) distances iteration Number calculated iterations umbral Threshold difference two contiguous \(P_{2}\) distances variables_sort Vector variable names entrance order determined last iteration correction_factors Correction Factors variable cor.coeff Correlation coefficient variable synthetic indicator (\(P_{2}\) distance) calculated partial.Indicators spatial entity difference reference vector value variable divided standard deviation. spatial entity, sum partial indicators Frechet Distance (DF), maximun value \(P_{2}\) distance can reach.

Welfare Indicators of European Countries — welfare
text: data frame 27 observations following 20 variables. happiness Mean value scale 1 'unhappy' 10 'happy'. Year: 2007 life.satis Life satisfaction: Share individuals aged 15 satisfied fairly satisfied life lead. Year: 2006 judicial Trust judicial system: Percentage people aged 15 tend trust justice legal system. Year: 2005 night Unsafe walk around night: Percentage individuals aged 18 think unsafe rather unsafe walk around area live night. Year: 2003 social Satisfaction social life: Percentage poplation aged 15 , fairly satisfied social life. Year: 2004 people Trust people: Mean value scale 1 'careful dealing people' 10 'people can trusted'. Year: 2007 family Satisfaction family life: Mean value scale 1 'dissatisfied' 10 'satisfied' family life. Year: 2007 health Satisfaction national health care system: Percentage individuals fairly satisfied national health system. Year: 2002 life.65 Life expectancy age 65: Average number years person age 65 live , time period, observed age-specific mortality rates remains constant. Year: 2003 life.0 Life expectancy birth: average number years person live , time period, observed age-specific mortality rate remains constant. Year: 2005 inequality Inequality income distribution: ratio total income received 20% population highest income (top quintile) received 20% population lowest income (lowest quintile). Year: 2005 hobbies little time hobbies interests: Percentage people aged 18 little time hobbies interests. Year: 2007 education Satisfaction education: mean value scale 1 'dissatisfied' 10 'satisfied' education. Year: 2007 standard Satisfaction standard living: Mean value scale 1 'dissatisfied' 10 'satisfied' present standard living. Year: 2007 dist.school Distance nearest primary school: Proportion people aged 15 live within walking distance within 20 minutes nearest primary school. Year: 1999, 2005 area Satisfaction area live : Share individuals aged 15 satisfied fairly satisfied area live five item scale. Year: 2004 home Satisfaction home: Share individuals aged 15 satisfied fairly satisfied home four item scale. Year: 2004 stress Find work stressful: Share people 'strongly agree' 'agree' work demanding stressful. Year: 2007 employement Employment rate: Employed persons aged 15-64 percentage total population age group. Year: 2005 job Job Satisfaction: Percentage employed people fairly satisfied job, measured four item scale. Year: 2005
